progress.blocker: The first replacement challenge evidence write finalized, but validator-side fetching returned url_reachable=false and content_hash_verified=false for the original dynamic CPSC HTML page. A later attempt to use a stable official CPSC PDF was blocked before submission when the API's authoritative challenge check hit StudioNet's 500-requests-per-hour RPC cap. The challenge remains open and funds remain in escrow.

challengeEvidence.note: The original add_evidence transaction finalized, but its digest was computed from a prior response body. The production API fetched the same URL at 2026-10-17 and returned SHA-256 b885d8a63b414225e8c797501602e1bec0b999ab587e0b4efbc9351212173045 for 75,705 bytes, demonstrating that the source body had changed. A replacement add_evidence transaction using that current production digest was attempted but rejected by the StudioNet RPC rate limiter before submission. No successful verification is claimed.

additionalChallengeEvidence.note: The write and verification transaction both finalized successfully, but the contract recorded a failed independent fetch/hash check. This evidence does not support adjudication.

hostedChecks.challengeSourceDigestEndpoint: Returned multiple changing digests for the dynamic 2019 HTML page; after the evidence writes, endpoint access was blocked by StudioNet RPC rate limiting during its authoritative on-chain challenger check

settlement.reason: The challenge remains open because neither submitted 2019 HTML evidence passed validator-side fetch/hash verification. A version-pinned official CPSC PDF was independently found to have stable bytes, but its add_evidence write has not been submitted. No payout or withdrawal is claimed.
